name: potools
description: 本机文件工具平台 · Vite + React + Node sidecar + Tauri
author: pohoc <po.hoc4@gmail.com>

scripts.package:macos: pnpm icons && pnpm tauri build --bundles dmg --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs macos
scripts.package:windows: pnpm icons && pnpm package:windows:x64:build && node scripts/package-windows-portable.mjs x64 && pnpm package:windows:x86:build && node scripts/package-windows-portable.mjs x86 && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs windows
scripts.package:windows:x64: pnpm icons && pnpm package:windows:x64:build && node scripts/package-windows-portable.mjs x64 && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs windows x64
scripts.package:windows:x86: pnpm icons && pnpm package:windows:x86:build && node scripts/package-windows-portable.mjs x86 && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs windows x86
scripts.package:linux:x64:build: node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs x64 && pnpm tauri build --bundles appimage,deb,rpm --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.package:linux:arm64:build: node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs arm64 && pnpm tauri build --bundles appimage,deb,rpm --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.package:linux:armv7:build: node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs armv7 && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,rpm --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
scripts.package:linux:ppc64le:build: node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs ppc64le && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,rpm --target powerpc64le-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.package:linux:s390x:build: node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs s390x && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,rpm --target s390x-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.icons: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && pnpm --filter @potools/desktop exec tauri icon "$PWD/apps/desktop/src-tauri/app-icon.png"
